content.short: Trakx is the leading platform for crypto-index trading.
content.description: Cryptocurrencies are complex and constantly changing, making it hard to stay informed and know where to invest. Trakx brings together a team of experts who curate both established tokens and emerging technologies, enabling you to invest in the crypto market through easy-to-understand themed baskets. These baskets group assets into clear, themed selections, helping you access meaningful exposure to crypto opportunities without guessing at individual coins or projects.
